title: Volatility
subtitle: Equity indices and commodities: realized vs implied
headline: Tuesday 27 October 2026. VIX 17.7 (mid-range), realized 9.8%, spread +7.8 points, curve in contango. The market charges +4.9 points over the HAR+IV model; FOMC in 1 day(s). Top idea: sell the 1-month ATM S&P straddle, delta-hedged daily.

sections.title: S&P 500 volatility
paragraphs: The VIX closed at 17.7, the 59th percentile of its trailing year (mid-range). The S&P 500 realized 9.8% over the last 21 sessions (14th percentile) and 10.8% over 63. Implied sits 7.8 points above realized: options are rich against recent history.

Since 2015 the one-month variance premium (implied today minus realized over the next 21 days) averaged +3.5 points and was positive on 83% of days. Today's +7.8 spread is above that average: the seller is paid more than usual going in.

The HAR+IV model, which debiases the VIX with past realized vol, forecasts 12.8% for the next month (pure HAR-RV: 11.6%). The gap between market and model is +4.9 points, in the '4 to 6' bucket. Historically in that bucket the forward premium averaged +3.8 points and was positive 81% of the time.

sections.title: Term structure
paragraphs: Curve: VIX9D 16.9, VIX 17.7, VIX3M 19.5, VIX6M 21.4, VIX1Y 22.4. VIX / VIX3M = 0.906, contango (normal: the market expects vol to mean-revert up). The curve has been inverted on 7% of days since 2015.

The forward vol between 30 and 91 days is 20.4%: that is what the market charges for month two and three, above spot VIX. VVIX at 99 and CBOE SKEW at 151 (83th pct) describe the vol-of-vol and tail pricing.

sections.title: Cross-asset
paragraphs: Among the assets with a CBOE implied index, WTI Crude has the richest options (IV 56.8% vs realized 38.9%, +18.0 points) and Nasdaq 100 the cheapest (+5.6 points). Realized vol percentiles over one year: S&P 500 14th, Nasdaq 100 61th, Russell 2000 24th, Euro Stoxx 50 68th, WTI Crude 41th, Gold 3th, Silver 8th, Natural Gas 73th.

sections.title: WTI crude
paragraphs: OVX at 56.8 (60th pct 1y) against 38.9% realized on the front future. The CLZ26 / CLZ27 calendar spread is +23.6%: the curve is in backwardation.
Samuelson effect today: CLZ26 (0.8 months out) realizes 33% against 11% for CLX27 at 12 months. News hits the front of the curve; the back is anchored by marginal cost.
Selling crude vol at the OVX level earned +4.3 points on average in backwardation (positive 74% of days, worst -40.4) versus -0.6 in the other regime.

sections.title: Scheduled events
paragraphs: Next FOMC decision: 2026-10-28 (1 days). It sits inside the 9-day tenor, yet VIX9D is 1.1 points below the 9d-30d forward: the contango is steep enough to hide the event premium, so the term-structure read is floored at zero. VIX9D alone implies a 1.07% daily move.

Over 94 meetings since 2015 the term structure priced an average 0.69% move and the S&P realized 0.80% (ratio 1.09, realized above implied on 35% of meetings, max ratio 6.3x on 2024-06-12). Event vol is fairly priced; the generic month is not: the carry lives in the days with no scheduled news.

sections.title: Skew (SPY 30d, last snapshot)
paragraphs: Snapshot 2026-10-27: ATM 13.7%, 25-delta put 16.7%, 25-delta call 12.1%, risk reversal -4.63 points, butterfly +0.66. 1 snapshot day(s) in the history so far.

method: Ideas are ranked by historical conditional expectation divided by the historical worst case in the same regime (expected P&L per unit of tail). Conditioning variables: the VIX minus HAR+IV gap bucket, the VIX / VIX3M curve bucket, the WTI Dec/Dec curve regime, the FOMC calendar. Gross of financing, net of hedge costs where stated.
caveats: Free data: Yahoo Finance closes and CBOE indices. Option quotes are delayed; implied vols are rebuilt from mids with Black-76.
Conditional statistics are in-sample averages over overlapping daily windows; treat small buckets as indicative.
The straddle backtest sells at the VIX level with 1 bp hedge cost and 0.5 vol point bid-ask; no margin, no financing.
